text: While the investigation goes on, if the tests keep coming back normal, I'd also look into two talk therapies that treat the pain as real: Pain Reprocessing Therapy and Emotional Awareness and Expression Therapy. So far they've mostly been tested on chronic back pain and other muscle and joint pain, where they helped most of the people who got them, so I can't say how they'd do for attacks like these (more on both in my somatic guide).
reader: an adult with pain attacks that tests keep explaining away, reading the inner child guide's Physical Pain section, deciding what to try while the doctors keep looking

question_text.Q1: Why am I reading this sentence, and do I know it before I have to work through it? (the point first, in each sentence and each paragraph; a study after the question it answers; a term explained where it is first used, never in a sentence after it)

question_text.Q4: What does each word act on, or mean here?
